text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment 
inspection I1,
which must be carried out on yearly bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the little block.
The low 
pressure evaporator is used receiving water from low pressure circulating pump 
and rising its temperature & pressure (by taking heat from exhaust gases coming 
from gas turbine) then transfer it to low pressure steam drum
The low Pressure Evaporator technical data
Medium | Exh. gases / 
 Water | No. of low pressure evaporators | 8
Material | SA 213 Gr.T1 | Design press. | 9 bar
Capacity | 43850 KG/H (Water) | Design temp. | 371 C
No. of rows | 6 Row *24 Tube | Material of fins | SA283 Gr.A
The first 
draft initiated by eng. Abdallah Saada, revised by eng. Ahmed Elsaaedy, 
accepted by eng. Magdey Hegazy, approved by eng. Khamis Elsherif Maintenance 
General Manager and approved by eng. Abd Elmoaty Elrakayby Head Sector of 
Mahmoudia Power Station.
This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC Inspection & Quality Control 
General Manager & MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb 
Inspection & Quality Controls Head Sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued 
 and the maintenance staff should be 
 trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet, 
 breathing mask, safety glasses.
The unit is out of service.
Put red tag on the high pressure super heater.
The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding of the zone of 
 work.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.
Argon welding machine.
Grinder & grinding wheel.
Work
to be Carried Out
Fill the low pressure section by filling water from low 
 pressure circulating pump after closing drain and opening the vents.
Inspect and adjust the leakage.
Drain the low pressure evaporator
Make hydraulic pressure test for 
 the low pressure section by running the low water pressure circulating pump to operating pressure.
Check that the distance between pipes 
 is equal.
Check the cleanliness of the 
 surface of pipes.
Check any cracks and use grinding 
 and argon welding according to the manual.
